target.title: fix(security): route temp workspaces through private OpenClaw temp root (#101224)
target.body:
Closes #101224

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where running `openclaw skills install` or `openclaw skills update` could change `/tmp` permissions from `0o1777` (sticky + world-writable) to `0o0700` (owner-only), breaking access to the shared system temp directory for other processes and services. Affects Linux hosts where `os.tmpdir()` resolves to `/tmp`.

The same bug affects ClawHub plugin (`openclaw plugins install clawhub:...`) and package archive downloads via the same code path.

## Why This Change Was Made

The root cause is that ClawHub skill and package download flows passed `os.tmpdir()` (`/tmp`) as the root directory to `@openclaw/fs-safe` temp workspaces, whose `ensurePrivateDirectory` helper calls `chmod(root, 0o700)` to enforce private permissions. When `root` is a shared OS directory like `/tmp`, this mutates system-level permissions.

The fix routes all temp workspace operations through `resolvePreferredOpenClawTmpDir()`, which returns the private `/tmp/openclaw` directory (or a user-scoped fallback `{os.tmpdir()}/openclaw-{uid}`). This directory is already owned by OpenClaw and has safe `0o700` permissions — changing its mode does not affect other system processes.

Six call sites were identified and unified: `withTempDir`'s default root in `install-source-utils.ts`, and 5 explicit `tmpDir: os.tmpdir()` overrides in `clawhub.ts` covering ClawHub skill archive downloads, skill archive URL downloads, GitHub source archive downloads, and package archive downloads (both archive and ClawPack artifact paths). No external API changes, no new dependencies.

## User Impact

ClawHub skill and plugin installation no longer risk corrupting `/tmp` permissions. All temporary workspace operations — ClawHub downloads, archive extraction staging, and git skill cloning — now consistently use the private OpenClaw temp root instead of raw `/tmp`. For most users this is invisible; for users running `auditd` or sharing a system with other services, `/tmp` sticky-bit and world-writable permissions are preserved.

## Evidence

- **Source-reproducible audit trail**: Issue reporter's `auditd` logs confirmed `chmod` syscalls on `/tmp` from the same process chain (`openclaw-skills`).
- **fs-safe source verification**: Published `@openclaw/fs-safe@0.4.1` `ensurePrivateDirectory` calls `fs.chmod(root, 0o700)` on the provided `rootDir`.
- **Focused regression coverage**: Added `install-source-utils.chmod.test.ts` that mocks an isolated parent temp root with `0o1777` permissions and verifies: (1) `withTempDir` uses the OpenClaw private temp root, and (2) the parent directory permissions remain unchanged (`0o1777`) after the temp workspace completes.
- **Test results (all pass)**:
  ```
  ✓ |infra| src/infra/install-source-utils.chmod.test.ts (1 test)
  ✓ |infra| src/infra/install-source-utils.test.ts (16 tests)
  ✓ |infra| src/infra/install-flow.test.ts (5 tests)
  ✓ |infra| src/infra/clawhub.test.ts (60 passed, 2 skipped)
  ✓ |infra| src/infra/tmp-openclaw-dir.test.ts (22 tests)
  ✓ |unit| src/skills/lifecycle/clawhub.test.ts (74 tests)
  ```
  
- **real behavior proof**
  ✓ PASS: /tmp permissions unchanged (1777) — temp workspace correctly isolated under /tmp/openclaw (700)
<details>
<summary>Terminal output</summary>

```

[my openclaw]$ export OPENCLAW_CLAWHUB_TOKEN="my-token"
[my openclaw]$ stat -c "%a %A" /tmp
1777 drwxrwxrwt
[my openclaw]$ node openclaw.mjs skills install @steipete/github --acknowledge-clawhub-risk
│
◇  

OpenClaw 2026.6.11 (164d1bf) — Gateway online—please keep hands, feet, and appendages inside the shell at all times.

11:55:05 [state-migrations] Legacy state migration warnings:
- Left Codex binding sidecar in place because its session is owned by agent harness openclaw: /home/bili/.openclaw/agents/main/sessions/2017b93c-b47a-4ec8-9331-1e897b3f1019.jsonl.codex-app-server.json                                                                  
│
◇  Doctor warnings ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│                                                                                                                      │
│  - Left Codex binding sidecar in place because its session is owned by agent harness                                 │
│    openclaw:                                                                                                         │
│    /home/bili/.openclaw/agents/main/sessions/2017b93c-b47a-4ec8-9331-1e897b3f1019.jsonl.codex-app-server.json  │
│                                                                                                                      │
├──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
Downloading github@1.0.0 from ClawHub…
Installing to /home/bili/.openclaw/workspace/skills/github…
Installed github@1.0.0 -> /home/bili/.openclaw/workspace/skills/github
[my openclaw]$ stat -c "%a %A" /tmp
1777 drwxrwxrwt
[my openclaw]$ stat -c "%a %A" /tmp/openclaw
700 drwx------

```

</details>
